Reschedule this meeting?
This re-checks everyone's live availability, asks the AI for a fresh set of ranked times, and lets you choose which to send. The current hold on the room is kept until the customer chooses. The existing invitation is withdrawn, and a note with the revised options is drafted for your review before anything is sent.
Cancel this meeting?
This releases the room, withdraws the Outlook invitations, notifies operations, and writes a cancellation to the audit trail. A cancellation note to the customer is drafted for your review — nothing reaches them until you approve it.
